label: Enable remote access
help: Off by default. While off, nothing is sent and no update is polled.

label: Bot token secret
help: Wallet reference holding the bot token from BotFather, never the token itself.

label: Allowed chat IDs
help: JSON array of numeric chat IDs, e.g. [123456789, -1001234567890]. Sends to other chats are refused and their updates are dropped.

label: Default chat ID
help: Chat used when an input gives no chat_id. It must also be allowed. Leave empty to require chat_id.

label: Text formatting
help: none sends plain text. MarkdownV2 and HTML require Telegram's escaping rules; invalid markup is rejected by Telegram.

label: Shareable files directory
help: Only regular files inside this directory can be sent from the file input. Empty disables file sending.

label: File send mode
help: auto sends JPEG/PNG files up to 10 MiB as photos and everything else as documents.

label: Receive messages
help: Active Runtime only: long-poll getUpdates from Run until Stop. One Shot never polls.

label: Update types
help: Subset of ["message", "edited_message", "channel_post", "edited_channel_post"]. Other update types are dropped.

label: Long-poll wait (s)
help: Seconds Telegram may hold one getUpdates call open when no message is waiting.

label: Send silently
help: Default for sent messages and files; recipients get no notification sound.

label: Disable link previews
help: Default for sent text messages.

label: Send deadline (s)
help: Total time for one send, including upload and retries after HTTP 429. Ambiguous sends are never retried.

label: Retries after HTTP 429
help: Only rate-limited sends, which Telegram did not process, are retried.

label: Longest retry wait (s)
help: A retry_after above this value returns a rate_limited error instead of waiting.

label: File size limit (bytes)
help: Upper bound for one uploaded file; Telegram accepts at most 50 MiB for documents and 10 MiB for photos.

label: Response size limit (bytes)
help: Larger Telegram responses are refused as protocol errors.

label: Updates per poll
help: Page size of one getUpdates call. Following pages are fetched with the next offset.

label: Published updates per minute
help: Bursts of up to 10. Extra messages stay on Telegram (24 hours at most) until the budget allows them.

label: Bot API origin
help: Keep https://api.telegram.org. Another HTTPS origin receives the bot token; plain HTTP is accepted only for a loopback test host.

label: Custom CA file
help: Optional absolute PEM file for a privately signed HTTPS origin. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
